# synthetic fixture mimicking `tofu state --help` output (OpenTofu is
# MPL-2.0; format reproduced by hand — see ../NOTICE.md)
Usage: jym-tofu [global options] state <subcommand> [options] [args]

  This command has subcommands for advanced state management.

  These subcommands slice and dice the state and are only needed in
  advanced cases. Commands that modify state first write a timestamped
  backup.

  Output is meant to compose with common Unix tools such as grep and awk.

Subcommands:
    list                List resources tracked in the state
    mv                  Move an item within the state
    pull                Download remote state to stdout
    push                Upload a local state file to remote state
    replace-provider    Swap the provider recorded in the state
    rm                  Remove items from the state
    show                Print a state item
